about: Frozen situational-trend presets. A preset has at most 2 filters, a registered market and (for tiered and watch-list presets) a registered side. Tiers come from the quality score and gates over completed seasons; the displayed tier never exceeds tierCeiling. Promotions happen only at season end after a full new season.

provenance.study: 2026-10-12 trend impact study (R1: 1,819 hypotheses, 1,722 with out-of-sample decisions; S1: quality score with a 100-permutation null). q is the Benjamini-Hochberg q-value over those 1,722 one-sided out-of-sample p-values, frozen here; model/trends/registry-frozen-2026-10-12.json keeps every id and p-value so q can be recomputed when hypotheses are added. Presets new since the study (totals reversion, second straight game abroad) have q = null and earn no multiplicity points.
provenance.fixtures: fixture = this engine on shared/trends/history-1999-2025.csv with shared/trends-corrections.json, through 2025. study = the original study values on the raw schedule file before the corrections (international roofs and weather, neutral sites, rest from the schedule, daylight-time zones).

scoreMax.statistic: best score in each shuffled run (thresholds.max.emp_p)

tier2Gate.note: The Tier 2 gate passes about as many rows on shuffled outcomes as on real ones; Tier 2 as a group is not distinguishable from chance.

bestOosRoi.note: Never rank by ROI: the best out-of-sample ROI on shuffled outcomes is as high as on real data.
